say:142:1064604109:1.male: You finally rise to your feet and notice a breakfast tray beside you. Blair must have had it brought in while you weren't paying attention.
say:142:1064604109:1.female: You finally rise to your feet and notice a breakfast tray beside you. Blair must have had it brought in while you weren't paying attention.

say:143:1064604110:1.source_cn: 走出屋外，已经是又一个清晨。

choice:133:0:1.text: Go on without me. I'll wait for him here.
choice:133:0:1.source_cn: 我在这里等着，你先走吧
choice:133:0:1.male: Go on without me. I'll wait for him here.
choice:133:0:1.female: Go on without me. I'll wait for him here.

choice:133:1:2.text: I'll stay here... just in case.
choice:133:1:2.male: I'll stay here... just in case.
choice:133:1:2.female: I'll stay here... just in case.

choice:120:0:1.text: Hey, what are you trying to do?
choice:120:0:1.male: Hey, what are you trying to do?
choice:120:0:1.female: Hey, what are you trying to do?

choice:96:0:1.text: That's why you didn't leave me in the lurch.
choice:96:0:1.male: That's why you didn't leave me in the lurch.
choice:96:0:1.female: That's why you didn't leave me in the lurch.

say:145:1064604073:1.source_cn: “天才都有相似之处”，这话果然不错。

choice:96:1:2.text: I feel the same way about you!
choice:96:1:2.male: I feel the same way about you!
choice:96:1:2.female: I feel the same way about you!

say:146:1064604074:1.text: Sometimes, that little bit is all it takes, my friend.
say:146:1064604074:1.source_cn: 有时候那一点就够了，朋友。
say:146:1064604074:1.male: Sometimes, that little bit is all it takes, my friend.
say:146:1064604074:1.female: Sometimes, that little bit is all it takes, my friend.

choice:96:2:3.text: My kindness is only enough to tip the scales slightly...
choice:96:2:3.source_cn: 我的善良只比邪恶多了那么一点点
choice:96:2:3.male: My kindness is only enough to tip the scales slightly...
choice:96:2:3.female: My kindness is only enough to tip the scales slightly...

choice:63:1:2.text: Holmes, get its attention off me!
choice:63:1:2.source_cn: 福尔摩斯，帮我分散它的注意
choice:63:1:2.male: Holmes, get its attention off me!
choice:63:1:2.female: Holmes, get its attention off me!

choice:45:1:2.text: I saw it burn to ashes with my own eyes!
choice:45:1:2.source_cn: 我见过它的尸体，它复生了！
choice:45:1:2.male: I saw it burn to ashes with my own eyes!
choice:45:1:2.female: I saw it burn to ashes with my own eyes!

choice:16:0:1.text: Let's just say I'm not much of a theatrical type.
choice:16:0:1.source_cn: 怎么说呢，我不是表演型人格
choice:16:0:1.male: Let's just say I'm not much of a theatrical type.
choice:16:0:1.female: Let's just say I'm not much of a theatrical type.

choice:16:1:2.text: It's the truth that matters, not the presentation!
choice:16:1:2.source_cn: 形式无关紧要，正确才是重点！
choice:16:1:2.male: It's the truth that matters, not the presentation!
choice:16:1:2.female: It's the truth that matters, not the presentation!

choice:6:0:1.text: Guess all those mystery novels I read paid off.
choice:6:0:1.source_cn: 多谢，因为我常看推理小说
choice:6:0:1.male: Guess all those mystery novels I read paid off.
choice:6:0:1.female: Guess all those mystery novels I read paid off.

say:149:1064604008:0.text: Ah, that's quite an illuminating clue, wouldn't you agree?
say:149:1064604008:0.source_cn: 啊，很明显的提示，是不是？
say:149:1064604008:0.male: Ah, that's quite an illuminating clue, wouldn't you agree?
say:149:1064604008:0.female: Ah, that's quite an illuminating clue, wouldn't you agree?

choice:148:0:1.text: Both the sword and the dagger found on your body are blunt.
choice:148:0:1.source_cn: 没开刃的仪式剑，与没开刃的匕首
choice:148:0:1.male: Both the sword and the dagger found on your body are blunt.
choice:148:0:1.female: Both the sword and the dagger found on your body are blunt.

choice:6:1:2.text: Actually, I've already figured it out.
choice:6:1:2.male: Actually, I've already figured it out.
choice:6:1:2.female: Actually, I've already figured it out.

say:1:1064604001:0.text: The secret passage is narrow, with dry air and bare stone walls—a stark contrast to the manor's elegant interior.
say:1:1064604001:0.source_cn: 暗门之后的甬道狭窄而干燥，墙壁以粗粝的石块砌成，与庄园...

say:21:1064604018:0.text: The passage turns at its end and opens into a small chamber. Smooth stone walls enclose the space, which is sparsely furnished.
say:21:1064604018:0.source_cn: 甬道在尽头转弯，随后豁然开朗。一间斗室出现在你们面前—...
say:21:1064604018:0.male: The passage turns at its end and opens into a small chamber. Smooth stone walls enclose the space, which is sparsely furnished.
say:21:1064604018:0.female: The passage turns at its end and opens into a small chamber. Smooth stone walls enclose the space, which is sparsely furnished.

say:2:1064604002:0.text: As you proceed, you realize the passage is leading toward the late Baronet Lambert's study...
say:2:1064604002:0.source_cn: 你判断着前进方向，这是在往老朗贝尔的书房延伸……
say:2:1064604002:0.male: As you proceed, you realize the passage is leading toward the late Baronet Lambert's study...
say:2:1064604002:0.female: As you proceed, you realize the passage is leading toward the late Baronet Lambert's study...
